lines.en: Pheely moves, a rustling noise accompanies it.
Its steps are heavy and cautious.
Pheely tiptoes, leaving no trace.

lines.zh: 洞穴中回荡着Pheely的脚步声。
lines.en: Pheely’s footsteps echo in the cave.

lines.zh: 它悄无声息地靠近玩家。
lines.en: It approaches the player silently.
Pheely crawls forward in the darkness.
Pheely’s pace quickens.

lines.zh: 它小心地移动，避开暗角。
lines.en: It moves carefully, avoiding dark corners.
Pheely weaves through the stone crevices.
It glides silently
Pheely inches along the stone wall.

lines.zh: 它踩碎一块碎石又立刻停住。
lines.en: It crushes a pebble and freezes at once.
Pheely stares into the cave's depths.

lines.zh: 我伏在暗处，眼珠一直跟着你。
lines.en: I crouch in the dark, my eyes tracking your every move.
Pheely stays quietly in the cave.

lines.zh: 它偶尔轻颤，似乎在思考。
lines.en: It occasionally trembles, as if in thought.
Pheely hides in the shadows.
It patiently waits for an opportunity.
Pheely’s gaze sweeps with alertness.
It seems to plan its next move.
Pheely stays still, vigilant.

lines.zh: 它的眼神中透露出贪婪。
lines.en: Its eyes gleam with greed.
Pheely holds its breath in the dark.

lines.zh: 弓弦被它轻轻拨了一下。
lines.en: It plucks the bowstring once, softly.

lines.zh: 它数着洞穴里滴水的声音。
lines.en: It counts the dripping of the cave.
Pheely crouches behind a stalagmite, silent.
Pheely suddenly turns to the player.

lines.zh: 它的目光锁定在玩家身上。
lines.en: Its gaze locks onto the player.
Its eyes hold a threat.

lines.zh: 它凝视着玩家，慢慢接近。
lines.en: It stares at the player, creeping closer.
Pheely’s stare makes the player uneasy.

lines.zh: 它紧紧盯着玩家，似乎要扑过去。
lines.en: It fixes its gaze on the player, ready to pounce.

lines.zh: Pheely的视线在玩家周围游走。
lines.en: Pheely’s eyes roam around the player.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里拉弓，你听不见。
lines.en: I draw from a crack in the rock. You won't hear.
Its gaze reveals malice.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛像两颗燃烧的火。
lines.en: Its eyes burn like two flames.
Pheely shows half a face from the crack.

lines.zh: 它把你的轮廓记进了眼里。
lines.en: It files your outline away in its eyes.

lines.zh: 你回头的瞬间，它已经藏好。
lines.en: You turn; it is already hidden.
Pheely's eyes shine in the dark.

lines.zh: 它顺着你的火把光看过来。
lines.en: It follows your torchlight to you.

lines.zh: 你听见弓被拉开的轻响。
lines.en: You hear the soft creak of a drawn bow.
Pheely watches the torch in your hand.

lines.zh: 它在估量你身上的护甲。
lines.en: It is sizing up your armor.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进了它的视线。
lines.en: Your shadow falls into its line of sight.

lines.zh: 它一动不动地看你走过。
lines.en: It watches you pass without moving.
You hit me!
You found me!
My quiver is empty, so I snatch up a stone.
My arrow won't hurt you!
You can't hide from me!
You're stronger. I'm backing off.

lines.zh: 我的肩被咬开，弓还握在手里。
lines.en: My shoulder is torn open, yet I still grip the bow.

lines.zh: 洞里射箭的，不止你一个。
lines.en: You're not the only one shooting in this cave.
You can't kill me!
I won't give in!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中，它露出半截身子，眼中全是猎物的光芒。
lines.en: Hisss, its eyes glint with prey.

lines.zh: 它悄无声息地接近，弓箭上弦，瞄准你。
lines.en: It approaches silently, drawing its bow.

lines.zh: 它的身影在黑暗中若隐若现，仿佛幽灵般飘忽。
lines.en: Its form flickers in the dark, like a phantom.

lines.zh: 寒光闪烁，箭矢破空而来，险些穿透你的皮肤。
lines.en: Flickering cold light, the arrow whizzes past, grazing your skin.

lines.zh: 它发出轻微的嘶鸣，似乎在挑战你的勇气。
lines.en: It hisses softly, challenging your courage.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，它的眼睛像是两颗红色的宝石，令人不安。
lines.en: In the dark, its eyes gleam like red gemstones, unsettling.

lines.zh: 它的身形在岩石间隐现，仿佛是自然的一部分。
lines.en: Its form appears and disappears among the rocks, a part of nature.

lines.zh: 它突然出现，射出一箭，消失在黑暗中。
lines.en: It appears suddenly, shoots an arrow, and vanishes into the dark.

lines.zh: 它低语着，仿佛在诉说着古老的故事。
lines.en: It whispers, as if recounting ancient tales.

lines.zh: 它的目光紧锁着你，仿佛要将你看穿。
lines.en: Its gaze fixes on you, as if seeing right through you.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它的箭矢，身体一震，几乎倒地。
lines.en: You collide with its arrow, staggering to the ground.

lines.zh: 箭矢穿透了岩石，险些命中你。
lines.en: The arrow pierces the rock, narrowly missing you.

lines.zh: 你惊魂未定，感到背后冷风飕飕。
lines.en: You're still shaken, feeling a cold breeze behind you.

lines.zh: 它射出的箭矢精准地击中了你。
lines.en: Its arrow strikes you with precision.

lines.zh: 你试图躲避，但它的箭矢无处不在。
lines.en: You try to dodge, but its arrows are everywhere.

lines.zh: 箭矢在你周围飞舞，几乎击中你的脸。
lines.en: The arrows dance around you, nearly striking your face.

lines.zh: 你被它的攻击吓得喘不过气。
lines.en: You gasp for breath, frightened by its attack.

lines.zh: 你被它的箭矢击中，鲜血染红了地面。
lines.en: You're hit by its arrow, blood staining the ground.

lines.zh: 它射出的箭矢如流星般划过夜空。
lines.en: Its arrows streak like meteors across the night sky.

lines.zh: 你惊慌失措，几乎被它的箭矢打中。
lines.en: You're panicked, barely dodging its arrows.

lines.zh: 它发出低沉的嘶鸣，寻找着伴侣的声音。
lines.en: It emits a low hiss, searching for a mate's call.

lines.zh: 它的声音在洞穴中回荡，回响着求偶的渴望。
lines.en: Its voice echoes through the cave, longing for a mate.

lines.zh: 它静静地等待，期待着伴侣的回应。
lines.en: It waits silently, hoping for a mate's response.

lines.zh: 它发出细微的声响，希望能引起对方注意。
lines.en: It makes a subtle sound, hoping to catch its mate's attention.

lines.zh: 它寻找着可以共鸣的声音，回应求偶的呼唤。
lines.en: It seeks sounds to resonate with, answering the call of love.

lines.zh: 它的声音在黑暗中显得格外清晰，如同心跳。
lines.en: Its voice stands out in the darkness, like a heartbeat.

lines.zh: 它耐心地等待着，似乎可以听见对方的心跳。
lines.en: It waits patiently, seeming to hear its mate's heartbeat.

lines.zh: 它的声音在寂静中回荡，寻找着最亲密的伴侣。
lines.en: Its voice echoes in the silence, searching for the closest mate.

lines.zh: 它发出急切的叫声，仿佛要立刻找到伴侣。
lines.en: It calls with urgency, eager to find its mate immediately.

lines.zh: 它发出的求偶声，回荡在古老的洞穴之中。
lines.en: Its mating call echoes through the ancient cave.
No breath. Not yet.
The ground speaks warnings.
You are watched by shadows.
Eyes in the dark.
Mild tremors beneath.
Your footsteps detected.

lines.zh: 无声的威胁在周围徘徊。
lines.en: Silent threats surround.
Distant whispers in silence.
Flickers in the dark.
Peril beneath the earth.
Hidden in the cave, arrow nocked.
You are in my sight.

lines.zh: 拉弦的手停在半空，我数你的脚步。
lines.en: My draw hand freezes midair as I count your steps.
Your presence felt.

lines.zh: 视线中出现了一个影子。
lines.en: Shadow in my sight.
You are within sight.
Bringing you into focus.
My next meal.

lines.zh: 洞顶的水滴声，盖不住你的鞋底。
lines.en: Dripping water cannot drown out your boot soles.
Aiming now.

lines.zh: 洞穴里多了一道拉弦声。
lines.en: A bowstring draws somewhere in the cave.
Pheely counts you into its hunting ground.
It picks you out as the living thing.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声被它记住了。
lines.en: It memorizes the sound of your steps.
Pheely decides to follow you tonight.

lines.zh: 它在暗处标下了你的位置。
lines.en: It marks your position from the dark.
Aim, ready to shoot.
Targeting you.
Locking shot.
Arrow at the ready.
Perfecting aim.
Aim, aim, aim.
Release the arrow.
Piercing you.
Arrow to your chest.
Aim, kill.
The arrowhead points at your neck.
Pheely waits for you to reach open ground.
It picks the moment you turn around.
The bow is full drawn and held.

lines.zh: 它瞄准你火把照不到的地方。
lines.en: It aims at the spot your torch misses.
You are in the light; it is in the dark.
Pheely has already worked out the arrow's landing.
It means to take your legs first.

lines.zh: 呼吸再慢一点，它就出手。
lines.en: One slower breath and it looses.

lines.zh: 箭羽在黑暗里轻轻颤动。
lines.en: The fletching trembles in the dark.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，箭矢嗖地飞来！
lines.en: Sssssss, arrow whizzing by!
Hiding in the shadows, a piercing arrow!
Sudden attack, arrow rain!
Silent attack, arrow flying!
Tracking prey, a deadly arrow!
Bowstring taut, arrow flying!
Hiding, silent arrow shot!
Arrow pierces, silent death!
Precision shot in the dark!
Tracking you, arrow coming!
An arrow pins the stone behind you!
Pheely's arrow grazes your ear!
You turn, and the arrow is already there!
The arrowhead comes wet from the cave!
Three shots cut off your retreat!

lines.zh: 你听见破空声才知中箭！
lines.en: You hear the hiss only after it hits!
Deep in the cave, silent.
Nightfall, silent.
Silent emergence in the dark.
Silent appearance in the cave.
Silent stalking in the dark.
Silent emergence in the depths.
Silent appearance under the night.
Silent appearance in the dark.
Silent lurking in the cave.
Nightfall, silent.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处亮起两点眼光。
lines.en: Two points of eyeshine light deep in the cave.

lines.zh: 第三天夜里，它开始活动。
lines.en: On the third night, it begins to move.

lines.zh: 岩石后传来弓弦上弦声。
lines.en: A bowstring tightens behind the rock.
Pheely appears at the end of the shaft.
A hunter steps out of the shadows.

lines.zh: 火把照不到的角落有动静。
lines.en: Something stirs where your torch fails.

lines.zh: 它从你身后的洞穴爬出来。
lines.en: It crawls out of the cave behind you.

lines.zh: 地下的猎手开始了狩猎。
lines.en: The hunter below begins to hunt.

lines.zh: 石壁上多了一道细长的影子。
lines.en: A long thin shadow joins the wall.

lines.zh: 你在洞穴口听见拉弓声。
lines.en: At the cave mouth you hear a bow draw.
Firelight burns my eyes shut

lines.zh: 我踩空石台，一路滚到洞底。
lines.en: I miss the ledge and tumble all the way to the cave floor.
Water fills my throat; I can't shoot
Blasted stone pins me down

lines.zh: 我自己的箭，被人射回来了。
lines.en: My own arrow has been shot right back at me.

lines.zh: 蓝光打穿我的肩膀，弓脱了手。
lines.en: Blue light punches through my shoulder and the bow slips free.
Hid too long — my quiver's empty.

lines.zh: 雷顺着石壁下来，我毛发全竖。
lines.en: Lightning runs down the stone wall and every hair of mine stands up.

lines.zh: 我的箭还没射完就掉了下去。
lines.en: My quiver fell with me.
